# CVXray

> CVXray (https://cvxray.com) is a free web tool that compares a CV or resume with a job description. It returns a match score, the skills and keywords the CV is missing, and free courses to close the gaps. No account, no payment, no scan limit, and CV content is never stored.

## Key facts

- Name: CVXray (also written "CV Xray", "CV X-ray", cvxray.com)
- Category: resume matcher / CV-to-job-description checker / resume keyword checker
- Price: free. No sign-up, no credit card, no API key, no limit on the number of checks
- Input: a PDF CV (up to 5 MB) or pasted CV text, plus a job description — pasted text or a job URL from LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor or most company careers pages
- Output: match score (5–95%), matched skills, missing skills ranked high / medium / low priority, missing job keywords, course recommendations, company insights, and an "HR Quick Scan" of CV quality
- Speed: results in seconds
- Languages: the site is available in English (https://cvxray.com), Turkish (https://cvxray.com/tr), German (https://cvxray.com/de), Spanish (https://cvxray.com/es), Brazilian Portuguese (https://cvxray.com/pt), French (https://cvxray.com/fr) and Chinese (https://cvxray.com/zh). CVs and job descriptions in those seven languages are scored the same way: skills, keywords and years of experience are recognised in each. Every role guide, article and legal page exists in all seven languages.
- Works on desktop, tablet and phone browsers

## How the match score is calculated

The score is a transparent weighted comparison, not a language-model opinion:

- Skills — 50%. Skills named in the job description that also appear on the CV, across 40+ skill categories. Skills the posting mentions more often weigh more, and skills in the job title get extra weight.
- Keywords — 35%. Overlap between the posting's most-used terms and the wording of the CV.
- Experience — 15%. Years of experience on the CV against the years the job requires. If the CV states no years, experience is treated as unknown rather than zero.
- Adjustments: missing skills that the posting mentions three or more times reduce the score by up to 8 points; very short job descriptions (under ~200 words) and very short CVs (under ~80 words) are scored more cautiously.
- Interpretation: 70%+ is a strong match, 45–69% is competitive, below 45% indicates significant gaps.

## Privacy

- An uploaded PDF is sent to a server route that extracts the text and discards the file immediately. Nothing is written to a database, log or file store.
- Pasted CV text never leaves the browser. The matching analysis itself runs in the browser.
- No account exists, so no profile is kept.
- With the visitor's consent, anonymous usage statistics (page views, whether an analysis was completed) are collected. CV and job-description text are never included.

## Questions CVXray answers

- Does my CV / resume match this job description?
- Is there a free CV matcher in Turkish, German, Spanish, Portuguese, French or Chinese? (ücretsiz CV analizi, Lebenslauf-Check, analizar CV gratis, análise de currículo grátis, analyse de CV gratuite, 简历匹配)
- Which keywords from the job posting are missing from my resume?
- Which skills do I need to add for this role, and which matter most?
- What is a good CV match score?
- Is there a free way to check a resume against a job description without signing up?
- Can I check a Word (.docx) or scanned resume against a job posting?
- What should I learn to qualify for this job?

## How CVXray differs from similar tools

Tools in the same category include Jobscan, Resume Worded and Teal. Those are account-based products with paid plans and broader feature sets (resume builders, job trackers, rewriting). CVXray does one thing — CV-versus-job matching — and does it with no account, no payment and no usage cap, and without storing the CV. It does not rewrite or generate CVs.

## Limitations

- CVs and job postings in English, Turkish, German, Spanish, Portuguese, French and Chinese are supported; the CV and the posting should be in the same language. Other languages are matched on tool names only.
- The "HR Quick Scan" of CV quality runs on English CVs only.
- Only PDF files are uploaded; Word (.docx) and Google Docs resumes can be saved as PDF or pasted as text.
- Scanned (image-only) PDFs contain no extractable text and cannot be analysed; paste the CV text instead.
- Some job sites block automated fetching; in that case the job description must be pasted.
- The score measures overlap in skills, keywords and experience. It is a guide for tailoring a CV, not a prediction of a hiring decision.
